👋Welcome to PARKOUR!

🏃‍♂️Run, slide and dash through 100+ stages
🌎Explore different worlds with brand new mechanics
🏁Race your friends for rewards
🔥Unlock cool powers that help you navigate hard levels
🥷Feel like an absolute ninja as you become the best obby player there is

⚠️Don't forget to like 👍 and favorite ⭐ the game and join our community for updates and leaks!
Community Group Link - https://www.roblox.com/communities/205834227

🎮Controls: (PC | Console)
Sliding - C / 1 | RT
Dashing - Q / 2 | RB
